mandatory_query_rules.rule: Every query MUST contain an explicit partition filter on 'event_date' bounded within the last 90 days. Full-table scans are blocked at the proxy.
You must invoke 'fetch_table_schema' to inspect current DDL before writing any SELECT statement. Never guess column names.
Dry-run query with EXPLAIN before physical execution. If estimated query cost exceeds $5.00, abort and request user confirmation.
